summary: Fix ConditionSet._eval_subs by preserving the bound symbol and letting the constructor reduce a true condition to the substituted base set. Remove the incorrect replacement-value membership check. Add issue 19495 regressions for ImageSet, FiniteSet, intervals, and integers, covering true/false/symbolic conditions and agreement with simultaneous subs/xreplace. Correct an existing expectation that encoded the same bug. Original issue reproduced with AssertionError before the fix. Public ConditionSet tests: 10 passed, 1 expected failure. Public sets suite plus test_solveset.py: 305 passed, 3 skipped, 19 expected failures; exit code 0.
